After 'docker compose stop api': 'HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway / Server: Caddy / Content-Length: 0' with NO Access-Control-Allow-Origin. issues.text: Expected result 2 and the whole Suggested answer are wrong for the browser app. Caddy's own 502 carries no Access-Control-Allow-Origin (that header comes from the api's CORS policy, which is stopped), and the app at :8081 is a different origin from :8080, so the browser blocks the response. Verified: headless Chrome fetch -> 'TypeError: Failed to fetch'; package:http 1.6.0 BrowserClient turns that into ClientException. fetchProducts never sees 502, so the learner sees a different message and the question's premise ('shows a status code of 502') is false.
issues.quote: 2 — the spinner, then "Could not load products: Exception: failed to load products (502)".
issues.fix: Replace expected result 2 with: 'the spinner, then an error such as "Could not load products: ClientException: Failed to fetch, uri=http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products" (wording depends on the browser).' Replace the question and suggested answer with one that does not rely on the 502 reaching the app, e.g. 'Why does the screen show an error and not a spinner that never ends?' -> 'The request fails, so the Future completes with an error; FutureBuilder builds again with hasError true and the error branch runs.' Do not introduce CORS (not in known_vocab). Update claim 6 accordingly.
